title: 【流感疫苗剩不到一半！開打還沒一個月「近376萬人搶打」】 大家都有去打嗎？ （#起啵）

tags.speaker: general_public
tags.storyline: Flu vaccine stock falling as uptake rises
tags.title_en: Flu vaccine supply below half as nearly 3.76 million rush to get it in under a month
tags.summary_en: The post says flu vaccine supply has fallen below half after nearly 3.76 million people received it in under a month, and asks whether others have gotten vaccinated.
